title: 第1521章 遇难都有神仙救围来的和尚顾虑第1520章 我只是在拿回我失去的一切活过来从今往后我是唐僧
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 金池站在废墟边缘。
晨光从东边斜斜地照过来，落在他身上。
他的嘴角慢慢翘起来，先然后压不住地往上扬，露出一种近乎酣畅的笑容。
一切都那么真实，像是他从一个活了两百年的旧壳子里爬出来，第一次用一具年轻的躯壳触碰这个世界。
他深吸了一口气，清晨的冷空气灌进肺里，胀满胸腔，整个身体随着呼吸微微扩张，温热而清晰。
“哈哈哈哈哈……”
他的笑声从喉咙里涌出来，先是低沉的，然后越来越大。
那笑声在废墟间回荡，惊起几只停在断墙上的鸟，扑棱着翅膀飞远了。
他笑弯了腰，双手撑在膝盖上，肩膀一抖一抖的。
他笑得太用力，咳了两声，直起身来，抹了抹眼角，脸上的笑容还是收不住。
是他的，终究是他的。
他等了两百年，修了两百年，拜了两百年，这一切都是他该得的。
那个从东土大唐来的陈玄奘，半路杀出来的和尚，凭什么抢走他的机会？凭什么顶替他的位置？
他才是那个应该西天取经、应该成佛、应该长生不老的人。
现在好了，一切都归位了。
年轻的身体，取经人的身份，佛祖的眷顾全都回来了，稳稳地回到了他该在的位置上。
他调整了一下呼吸，把脸上的表情收起来，换成一副温和的、带着慈悲的微笑。
那种微笑是他这两百年来最熟悉的。
嘴角上扬的弧度、目光放低的柔和、眉间微微舒展的姿态。
他练习过无数遍，对着镜子练，对着佛像练，对着来上香的香客练。
他笑起来的样子，和一个得道高僧没有任何区别。
不远处传来脚步声。
金池转过头，看到孙悟空从一片倒塌的院墙后面绕过来。
猴子的脚步不紧不慢，踩在碎瓦和炭灰上，发出细碎的声响。
他身后跟着四个身形高大的身影，穿着铠甲，手持兵器，周身散发着一股淡淡的金光。
是四大天王！！
连传说中的四大天王都下凡了！！
孙悟空走到离金池两三丈远的地方停下来，目光落在‘唐僧’身上，有些复杂。
他上下打量了几眼，像是在确认什么，又像是在等什么。
他张了张嘴，又合上了。
昨天夜里大火烧起来的时候，他一直蹲在远处的山上看着。
他听到了唐僧的喊声，看到了火舌从窗缝里冒出来，但他没有动。
他就是想看看，这和尚死了之后，佛祖是不是还会再来救他。
如果救了，那就证明这和尚命不该绝；如果不救，那他头上的金箍也许就能摘下来了！
但他没想到的是，火灭了，和尚还活着！
而且活得跟没事人一样，站在那里，笑得像个中了大奖的傻子。
四大天王也看了唐僧一眼，没有多说什么，朝金池拱了拱手。
为首的增长天王开口道：“唐长老既然无恙，我等便回天庭复命了。”
金池连忙双手合十，微微躬身，姿态恭敬而不失方寸，“四位上仙慢走，贫僧昨夜遇险，承蒙四位上仙相助，感激不尽。”
content_en:
Jinchi stood on the edge of the ruins.
The morning light slanted over from the east and fell on him.
The corners of his mouth slowly turned upward, first and then uncontrollably, revealing an almost hearty smile.
Everything is so real, as if he crawled out of an old shell that had lived for two hundred years and touched the world for the first time with a young body.
He took a deep breath, and the cold morning air poured into his lungs and filled his chest. His whole body expanded slightly with the breath, warm and clear.
"Hahahahaha..."
The laughter rose from his throat, first low, then louder.
The laughter echoed among the ruins, startling a few birds that were parked on the broken wall, and flapped their wings and flew away.
He bent over with a smile, put his hands on his knees, and his shoulders shook.
He laughed so hard that he coughed twice, straightened up, and wiped the corners of his eyes, but he still couldn't hold back the smile on his face.
It's his, it's his after all.
He has waited for two hundred years, practiced for two hundred years, and worshiped for two hundred years. He deserves all of this.
Why did Chen Xuanzang, the monk who came from the Eastern Tang Dynasty, come out halfway, take away his opportunity? Why take his place?
He is the one who should seek Buddhist scriptures from the West, who should become a Buddha, and who should live forever.
Now, everything is in its place.
His young body, his identity as a sutra collector, and the Buddha's favor all came back, firmly returning to his rightful place.
He adjusted his breathing, put away the expression on his face, and replaced it with a gentle, compassionate smile.
That smile was the one he was most familiar with in the past two hundred years.
The corners of the mouth are raised, the eyes are lowered softly, and the eyebrows are slightly relaxed.
He practiced countless times, practicing in front of the mirror, in front of the Buddha statue, and in front of the pilgrims who came to offer incense.
The way he smiled was no different from an enlightened monk.
There were footsteps not far away.
Jinchi turned his head and saw Sun Wukong coming around from behind a collapsed courtyard wall.
The monkey's steps were slow and unhurried, stepping on the broken tiles and charcoal ash, making a soft crunching sound.
Behind him were four tall figures, wearing armor and holding weapons, with a faint golden light emitting from their bodies.
They are the Four Heavenly Kings! !
Even the legendary four heavenly kings have descended to earth! !
Sun Wukong walked to a place two or three feet away from the golden pond and stopped. His eyes fell on 'Tang Monk', which was a little complicated.
He looked up and down a few times, as if confirming something or waiting for something.
He opened his mouth and closed it again.
When the fire burned last night, he had been squatting on the mountain in the distance and watching.
He heard Tang Seng's shouts and saw tongues of fire coming out of the cracks in the window, but he did not move.
He just wanted to see if the Buddha would come to save him again after the monk died.
If he is saved, it proves that the monk's life should not be cut off; if he is not saved, then maybe the golden hoop on his head can be taken off!
But what he didn't expect was that after the fire was out, the monk was still alive!
And he lived like nothing happened, standing there and smiling like a fool who had won a jackpot.
The four heavenly kings also glanced at Tang Seng, and without saying anything else, they cupped their hands towards Jinchi.
The leader, the King of Growth, said: "Since Elder Tang is fine, we will return to heaven to resume our lives."
Jin Chi hurriedly clasped his hands together and bowed slightly, his posture respectful but not compromising. "Four immortals walked slowly. The poor monk was in danger last night. I am grateful to the four immortals for their help."
title_en: Chapter 1521: Even in times of crisis, the monks who come to rescue me are worried. Chapter 1520: I am just getting back everything I lost and come back to life. From now on, I am Tang Monk.
